name: MediaFetch Pro Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: v1.7.0: Major UI/UX release featuring Frosted Glass, Clear Glass, and Blur Glass themes; customizable 2-color Ambient Glow gradient engine with preset save; direct flat folder download mode; full pure white theme support with high contrast; cross-app settings sync between Premiere Pro & After Effects; and aggressive low-RAM mode performance tuning for 8GB systems.
Fixed YouTube premieres and upcoming live stream metadata detection with cover download.
Resolved continuous update alert popup by synchronizing build version code.
Full multi-media extraction for Behance projects and carousels across desktop and mobile APK.
Fixed links and download handling across all platforms without failure.
